summary: You can now try a page of components: point at a button and it shows its Hover look, press it and it shows Pressed, click a switch and it stays On, and Tab moves Focus. Leaving puts everything back.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Open a picture holding copies of components that have looks named Hover, Pressed, On and so on.

try.do: Press Preview in the title bar, or ⌘Return.
Rest the pointer on a button.
Hold the mouse down on it, slide off, and let go: no click.
Click a switch, then move away: it stays On.
Click another tab: one stays picked, and it keeps its words.
Point at a component with no state looks and read the pill.
Press Tab a few times, then Space on a tab.
Press Esc: your selection, zoom and Undo are as you left them.

evaluate: Does a page you made yourself behave the way you expected, with nothing to set up?
Does the pause coming out of Preview bother you on a real page?
Is it clear enough what on the page is live, with no hint from us?
Should measurements on the page hide in Preview? Today they stay.
rough: Reel: 2026-11-06-component-preview-reel.mp4, frames on 2026-11-06-component-preview-sheet.png. It is a slide show of the walk's pictures, not a film of a hand.
Coming out of Preview stalls for about 0.37 seconds on a 30 layer page, going in about 0.2. Filed as its own task.
A copy's own words sit 7 to 11 points off centre in the control. This is older than Preview and filed as its own task.
Going in only folds the window when it happens on its own turn of the main loop. We measured that and worked round it in the command; why SwiftUI does this is not known.
A row picked by hand from the menu bar in Preview still acts on the document, though most are dimmed because nothing is picked. The keys for them are stopped.
A copy showing a look other than the first keeps its words but its panel may not offer them to edit. Read in the code, not tried.

No difference from component-preview.html was seen beyond this: the page is centred above the pill rather than in the whole window, which is the same promise that the pill never sits on the page (decision preview-a-page-of-components-and-use-it-hover-pr-should-a-page-of-components-work).
